content: Mwapale bhajhino na nkotoka kukipala mabhene
Twenga bhitukangamile mu kihobholelo itupala kwatangatila bhala bhibhabhii bheyabheya mu kihobholelo kughegha malola ghabhe. Tukotoka kukipala tabhete tugha.
Kila jhumo pakate jhito ipalwa ahuanganila nnyake kwa matyangilo ghambone ndi akangamaliche mukihobholelo.
Nhwalo Kilichitu akatumbwiijhe kukipala jwenio, ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga, “Maligho ghoha ghibhanighita mwenga, ghahikii nenga.”

Bhahe, kwa ghoha ghighalongolila kujhandikwa mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga, ghajhandikwe kwa nhwalo jha kutubhola twenga, ndi kwa luhimba na kupepechwa na Majhandiko gheniya, tuhoto kubhehe na lihobholelo.
Chapanga jhuna luhimba na jwapepecha, abhaleke mwojho gwa kubhehe kilebhe chimo kwa kukengama ghatehila Yecho Kilichitu,
ndi, mabhoha mwenga mme kilebhe chimo na lilobhe limo, lya kunomba Chapanga, Tate gwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu.
Lilobhe lya Mbone kwa bhando bhoha
Bhahe, mu pokelane mabhene kwa mabhene ngita Kilichitu champokii mangota, ndi Chapanga alombwe.
Nhwalo nilonge kubhehe, Kilichitu akabhahengii Akayahude apata kulangii uchakaka gwa Chapanga, na kulenganikiya malaghano gha Chapanga ghabhapekiya akahoko bhito ibhehe telatela,
na ata bhando bhamba bha ilambo yoha bhanombe Chapanga kwa nhwalo jha kiya jhake. Ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga,

content.text: “Kwa gheniya naninomba pakate jha bhando bha ilambo yoha.

content: Helahela Majhandiko ghilonge,

content.text: “Unhanganile mangota bhando bha ilambo henge, unhanganile pamonga na bhando bhake!”

content: Na kabhele Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge

content.text: “Ma ilambo yoha, munombe Bhambo, mangota bhando bha ilambo henge,

content: Kabhele Isaya jwakibha nnondole jwa Chapanga ilonge,

content.text: na jwenio nabhalongocha bhando bha ilambo,
na bhando bha ilambo henge, natunhobholela jwenio.”

content: Bhahe, Chapanga jwabhii ndi nchinge gwa lihobholelo, antweleya luheko loha na uteeke kuhumii mu kihobholelo chino, na lihobholelo lino lijhonjekeke kwa likakala lya Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Lihengo lya Pauli
Makalongo bhango, namwete chakaka manye kubhehe mangota hele ntwelii umbone na umanye ghoha. Mihoto kubholana mabhene kwa mabhene.
Nambo ninyandikile baluwa jhenje ilebhe mbwe changabwaghaliya, nipala nikomboche kabhele. Ndehi naha kwa nhwalo jha umbone ghola gwambekii Chapanga,

jha kubhehe natumiche jwa Yecho Kilichitu kwa bhando bha ilambo henge. Nihenga lihengo lya Mupiya litambiko lya kutangacha Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Chapanga mbala bhando bha ilambo yoha bhabhehe matambiko ghighapokelelwa na Chapanga, matambiko jhijhelewilwe na Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Nhwalo kwa kulombana na Kilichitu Yecho, nihoto kukilokela lihengo lyango ndi kwa nhwalo jha Chapanga.

Nilogwa jhe kujhonjekeya kulonge kilebhe chenge chochoha, ndi chela tugha kubhehe Kilichitu Yecho akatei kunduma, nenga mbata bhando bha ilambo yoha bhanyokanikihe Chapanga. Ateila naha kwa kulonge na kwa kuhenga,

kwa likakala lya ikangacho na nginyililo, na kwa likakala lya Uhuke gwa Chapanga. Bhahe, hotwi kujhenda, kuhumii ku Yeluchalemo ade ku Iluliko, kila chehemo, ndangiche maha Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Kilichitu.
Chinipala namwete machiko ghoha ndangache Lilobhe lya Mbone popoha pala liina lya Kilichitu linajhokanikikajhe, ngotoka kuchenga nchinge gwa mundo jhonge.
Ngita hela chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga,

content.text: na bhala bhanajho jhe malobhe ghake, nabhajhoha.”

content: Pauli ipala kutyangii ku Loma
Ghono ndi nhwalo ghuhibhilikiya mala jhamahele nenga kuhika kwino.
Nambo ngoheno nyomwile lihengo lyango mu ilambo yenio, na kabhele kuhumii yaka yamahele mbata kuhika kwino,
nihobholela kuhenga lyenio ngoheno. Punipala kujhenda ku Chipaniya nambeta kuninga, peniya nipala mangota utangatile kuhika kwenio putujhomolela kuhangana na mangota kwa machiko ghandina.
Nambo ngohe nijhenda ku Yeluchalemo kwahengela bhando bha Chapanga bhibhabhii kwenio.
Nhwalo bhando bha likunde lilinyeketii Kilichitu lya ku Makedoniya na lya ku Akaya lihamwii kubhoha michango jha kwatangatila bhando bha Chapanga bhibhabhii akahocho bhibhabhii kwenio ku Yeluchalemo.

Bhene bheniya bhakawe mbone kuhenga gheniya, na chakaka bhapalitwa kuhenga yenio. Nhwalo bhando bha ilambo henge bhakapokii mota ya kihuke kuhumii kwa Akayahude, na bhene hele bhapalwa hele kwabhaghulila ilebhe ya machiko ghoha.
Bhahe, pumbala kujhomolela lihengo hele na kwahikichila ilebhe ichangwite kwa nhwalo gwabhe, nanityangila mangota pumbala kujhenda ku Chipaniya.
Nimanya punihika kwino, nihika na mota mbwe ya Kilichitu.
Bhahe, akalongo bhango, nimpembekeya Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu na kwa upalo ghuletwa na Uhuke, tubhehe kilebhe chimo kwa mukunyope hake kwa Chapanga.

Unyopele kwa Chapanga moke njelembo pakate jha bhando bhangajheketela Kilichitu bhibhabhii ku Yudeya, na unyopele lihengo lyango ku kilambo cha ku Yeluchalemo lijheketelwe na bhando bha Chapanga bhibhabhii kwenio.
Bhahe, anda Chapanga apahile, nihoto kuhika kwino kwa luheko, na mbomolele pamo na mangota.
Chapanga jwabhii lihembuko lya uteeke abhaha na mangota mabhoha. Amina!
